notes.title: Hot-Fix For Game Update V0.0.3H
notes.notes:
Basically, just a hot-fix for the most recently updated patch.

Changes In This Update:
• [b]Removed[/b] extra tutorial button that was still next to login button.
• Loading screen was getting stuck while in solo-mode. [b]Added[/b] a change to fix that.
• BZ-00 (Tutorial NPC) did not have a collider ([b]now it does[/b])
• BZ-00 (Tutorial NPC) had an incorrect name-tag ([b]now it shows the correct name & title[/b])
• [b]Quest Tracker[/b] was getting stuck in the tutorial -- This behavior was abnormal due to the way the tutorial mission was added to your mission queue when it was tracked. The tracking remnant is now removed upon completing the tutorial step.
• [b]Board Going Through Player[/b] -- This behavior was abnormal due to the way the "CLASSIC" board type was loaded. It worked for female characters, but the offset and size were incorrect for male characters. The offset has been corrected.
• [b]NPC Quest Markers[/b] - They should now update each time you have a conversation, complete a quest, or advance a quest. (Needs more definitive testing)
• *EXPERIMENTAL* Camera Controls - RMB (Right Click Hold) may now move your camera up and down at a limited angle, it is very sensitive currently and will be revised in a future patch. This feature is experimental, and will be optional in the future.
•  *EXPERIMENTAL* Camera Controls - RMB (Right Click Press) will now automatically rotate your toon in the direction you are facing. This feature is experimental, and will be optional in the future.

• [b]Disclaimer Added[/b] - A new disclaimer agreement has been added to the login menu. [b]In order to play from henceforth, you must accept the agreement[/b] before you can login. It simply states that you will try to report any bugs experienced with active communication [u][b]before you leave a review. [/b][/u]

This will give me an opportunity to address your needs, and fix the problem for the entire community. I am a solo-developer, there is a lot I need to manage as I create more content and some things can slip by me. I would appreciate your reporting, and make a better experience out of the game with your feedback.

Shoutout to Sphinctus for pointing out some of these bugs, the rest will be handled appropriately with the new systems arriving in the following patches.

Thank you kindly for reading,
InfiniteHeavenlyDragon

notes.title: December 2024 Content Update
notes.notes:
[h3][u]Greetings Explorers, Researchers, Boarders, & Hunters![/u][/h3]

With the launch out of the way, and the holidays upcoming, there is still a lot that must be done for future updates. This is why I have considered some of the feedback that has already been submitted, and added onto the game.

That major update inside of this current version is a change to how you are supposed to login. People who have played already have communicated to me that they were having issues with "multiplayer". The one thing I'd like to point out is, whenever you login: [b]You are connected to the main server already, and you can join a snowboarding event from anywhere in the overworld.[/b]

The way the matchmaking system used to work was:
1. You would start matchmaking via the shortcut bar
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244362/2e6fb9ca735484774d0529e517d4c795264ecd43.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244362/fce191dd2c6973278d5af331e497f07232c26a34.png[/img][/url]

2. Select your gamemode of choice
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244362/9439e274387ff5cec6689bbb2305fec4561dca6f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244362/a06d0c321cfe7ab16dc877aa67d95b8d9ea7bb07.png[/img][/url]

3. Click play to start matchmaking
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244362/4a512566201bd8f8b2be0553f4ee45615e6e4406.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244362/c496beda1ed4010ff3c49127bf5a71e8d35943c1.png[/img][/url]

Now, that seems a bit confusing to some people because they would arrive to an empty lobby, and think that something is wrong. The game just released and [b]there was nobody online at the time[/b], so nobody would join their game and [b]allow them to start[/b] because each game type had a minimum requirement of several people instead of just one. 

[b]This was an obvious issue, leading players to think that the multiplayer had yet to be implemented or broken, and that's bad.[/b]

So the solution I'm incorporating into this update is a new login system, and hub, to further simplify the UI and give better information to players. [u]Now when you login is a new menu that allows you to [b]CHOOSE [/b]what you'd like to do, and where you'd like to go:
[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244362/4688e7b82c4a767d921757ccce250a942669df6f.png[/img]

With the new menu you can select whether you would like to login directly to the [b]overworld, hub, or your room![/b]

[b]The Hub[/b] is a new location that can allow you to see lobbies and their information. You can then join based off its current status (whether its full or not). Once you've joined a lobby, you will see a familiar screen that will be an in-world room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244362/b6080747a00003857fd6ad6ec22dd7ea4a3cd626.png[/img]

With this update, also comes a [b]Time-Attack / Practice[/b] mode. [u][b]If there are not enough players online, or you cannot find a lobby, you may still try some of the maps in this mode.[/b][/u] You may also login to the OverWorld for more content to explore!

That is all the content for this patch.

I'll be adding more maps, better visuals, animations, items, and overall content in the coming weeks. So make sure you stay tuned and keep an eye out for more!

Thank you for reading,
InfiniteHeavenlyDragon
~Imysoo Games Developer
